responsibility: Supplies Arm target configuration defaults for BPABI/EABI-based environments. It selects AAPCS as the default ABI, enables BPABI conventions such as EABI unwinding tables, default interworking, BPABI linker/assembler specs, init/fini array usage, RTTI-comparison policy, endianness defaults, and profiling hooks, thereby specializing the generic Arm backend for BPABI-compliant toolchains and runtimes.
